propositions: The comment at runner.py:94-97 claiming extra_tools 'is always None in practice' is stale; extra_tools is live and used by completion_recovery.py and workflow/runs.py for token-recovery tooling.

Three sites in runner.py/structured.py contradict each other on whether Anthropic 400s occur with extended-thinking and native output constraints; the true gate is native_structured_output and (not thinking or native_output_with_thinking), not json_schema output alone.

capabilities.py:166-198 contains a structurally complete ADR documenting web-search capability security posture (BLOCKING gate, three numbered bounds, accepted limitation) that should be relocated to a new ADR (0063) rather than remain as a buried comment.
providers.py:3-16 duplicates ADR 0059 §1 verbatim including file:line citations and should be collapsed to a one-line citation.
Measured-fact comments (capabilities.py:295-316 AWS-cost matrix, capabilities.py:269-281 rejected-alternative warning) must be preserved verbatim as DO_NOT_MOVE to prevent reintroduction of mistakes.
runner.py C901 headroom recovery of ~46 net comment/docstring lines across llm scope enables 4-5 additional stories without another method split.
